risks.risk: Exact engine make/model and compatibility are unclear; wrong engine could be purchased.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the engine identification plate/engine code (stamped code on block/head) and the full label on the intake/ECU area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used tokunbo engine with unknown exact spec (worst-case match risk).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” may be false or unverified; could have hidden faults.
risks.proof: Request a short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) plus a diagnostic scan screenshot (OBD) showing no stored critical faults.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as needs inspection/possible faults).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories or incomplete assembly (alternator, starter, sensors, ECU, harness condition).
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo: show what is included (ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, coils, wiring harness connectors) laid out and labeled.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in one photo (oil leaks, cracks, bent mounts, compression problems).
risks.proof: Request close-ups of suspected leak points and a compression test / leak-down test result (photos of gauge readings).
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown condition (worst-case: assume potential leaks/low compression).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the engine block/head (the part that determines exact model).
Send a video of the engine running (ideally cold start) and an OBD/diagnostic screenshot showing no critical faults.
Confirm what is included in the sale (ECU, starter, alternator, coils, sensors, wiring harness, intake parts) with photos of all included items.
Provide close-up photos of any seals/gaskets and suspected leak areas, plus compression/leak-down test results if available.
response.reason: From the single photo, the exact engine identity/spec and the seller’s “tested/working, no knock, low mileage, never opened” claims cannot be verified. Without the engine code/spec and proof of running/diagnostics, a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable.
